scope: Pure captured bytes only. Generic writer-chain integrity and an explicitly distinct known-launched native-parent policy are separate results; neither qualifies an actual run or profile.

source_references.format: The accepted writer emits kind_reserved, then sequence/event/details/previous_sha256/sha256 rows. Native parent requests kind=build.
Canonical sorted compact ensure_ascii=False UTF8 JSON, no nonfinite values. Generic parse_json utf8-sig behavior is NOT sufficient for exact journal framing.
detached_recognition_* attempt/terminal and recognition_* lease/hash events; source-bound protocol, limits, config and report references.
One recognition_file_hash_reserved/returned pair per completed leased hash, with path/role/expected bytes and returned hash.
RunJournal(kind=build), actual abi_* suspended creation/assignment/resume/snapshot events, not application dispatch/usage events.
detached_ABI_terminal_call_reserved labels and after_wait raw snapshot, with references into the retained parent report.

source_inspection.identity_limit: Read source text for format; no old source/original receipt identity was freshly revalidated for this task. Any future real invocation needs fresh source-bound owner context.

API.check_chain: check_chain(raw:bytes, *, check:callable) -> deeply immutable chain summary/records
API.check_native_v7: check_native_v7(raw:bytes, bindings:mapping, *, check:callable) -> deeply immutable source-order/reference summary
API.raw_type: Exact bytes only; no path, filename object, stream or file handle argument; no implicit reads.
API.path_strings: Journal/config path strings are uninterpreted expected metadata compared byte/value-exactly. No Path/resolve/stat/open/environment access.
API.deadline: Required caller-injected callable, no numeric start/deadline or reset. Check before/after each <=65536byte in-memory journal hash chunk, each bounded row parse/canonical/hash step and each bounded semantic/reference step. Callback exceptions propagate and never become a successful or inconsistent-data result.
API.errors: CapturedJournalError contains bounded reason/index/partial counts. No raw complete payload or filesystem fallback. No native/resource/profile success inferred.

framing.encoding: Strict scalar UTF8, no BOM. Split ONLY actual ASCII LF bytes, not Unicode splitlines().
framing.termination: Nonempty payload and final LF required; blank records, CRLF, missing final LF and incomplete tails cannot pass.
framing.allocation: Validate total size first. Iterate bounded LF positions; do not split an arbitrarily many-line payload into an unbounded list before checking event count.
framing.canonical: Each JSON record must equal its exact sorted compact ensure_ascii=False UTF8 serialization. Reject duplicate names, nonfinite values, escaped/unpaired surrogates, extra whitespace, alternate escapes and noncanonical framing.
framing.sequence: Exact int, not bool, starts0 and increases1.
framing.event: Nonblank printable ASCII identifier length1..128; no source meaning is implied by generic chain integrity.
framing.details: JSON object; bounded nesting. Known counters in the native policy have exact integer types and bounds, never bool coercion.
framing.digest: sha256 is lowercase64hex. Recompute SHA256(canonical(record without sha256)); previous_sha256 is null only for sequence0, otherwise the prior actual row digest.
framing.chain_result: Returns raw-byte digest, event count, observed tip and deeply frozen rows. Explicit source_order_validated=False, profile_qualified=False. A generic application run_reserved chain never becomes a native-policy pass.

native_policy.scope: One known created/assigned/resumed child and complete normal terminal-observer/final-recheck path. The terminal run may be consistently failed; journal completeness never changes that outcome.
native_policy.early_failure: Valid early/prelaunch failures may have a valid generic chain but are OUTSIDE this known-launched policy's completeness scope. Return/raise explicit incomplete/unsupported source order; never launder generic integrity into native completeness.
native_policy.future_profile: New Unicode parent/event policy requires an explicit future version/source binding. No old189case/six-prefix success predicate or runtime authority is supplied by this checker.
order: Initial ordered file epoch: for every binding, recognition_lease_attempt_reserved then recognition_file_hash_reserved then recognition_file_hash_returned
abi_job_snapshot_observed running_first ordinal3, then zero or more running_periodic snapshots with contiguous ordinals
Zero or more detached_ABI_terminal_call_reserved capture_available_stdout/stderr and optional immediately paired capture_read_stdout/stderr, in the retained report's global poll order
detached_ABI_terminal_call_reserved terminal_job_snapshot, followed by abi_job_snapshot_observed after_wait with the next ordinal
Final ordered file epoch with the same complete lease/hash triplets and source bindings
native_policy.event_namespace: Closed to the exact names/order above. Application run_reserved/dispatch/usage, unknown events, duplicate creation/resume/terminal and trailing rows reject native completeness even with recomputed valid hashes.
native_policy.file_bindings: Exact ordered original path/role/bytes/sha256 projections of the captured config input roster plus the two source-declared owner protocol files. Equal across both source epochs; no path is opened.
native_policy.file_references: Each hash-return event must match the corresponding captured parent_report.role_hash_records projection: statusverified/hash_complete true, path/role, expected bytes, known-returned bytes, computed digest and no pending read. The source report's declared counters remain instrumentation, not a fresh hash pass.
native_policy.counter_types: Owner/child/thread IDs positive exactint<=2^32-1; ordinal exactint1..40; byte counts exactint0..2^63-1; flags/attribute keys exactint; booleans compared with exact types.
native_policy.creation: Config argv/environment/flags exactly match bindings; attribute_count2, keys[131074,131085], positive noninherited job handle. Created PID/thread match assigned identity and resume PID; assigned image equals expected executable; creation FILETIME positive exactint; assigned_during_CreateProcessW true and manual_assignment_fallback false.
native_policy.snapshot_scope: Require exact source stage/ordinal order and retain raw-reference pointers. Final after_wait snapshot must exactly match captured parent_report.final_job_snapshot and terminal_observation job snapshot. Raw ACCOUNTING/PID decoding/phase/limits correctness is DELEGATED to the separate resource gate, never established by journal-chain validity.
native_policy.terminal_call_scope: At most64 availability reservations, each optional read immediately follows its same-stream availability; at most64 reads, then exactly one job snapshot and one memory observation. Match the captured terminal-observation call records/flags/poll order, not a caller-supplied ready list.
native_policy.terminal: Status and failure exactly match captured parent report; expected resumption is observed_resumed and final_input_recheck is completed with matching ordered paths/known read-close returns. Both consistent source-positive and source-negative terminals may have complete journals, but returned profile_qualified is always false.

binding_context.projection_rule: parent_report is a closed projection of those actual retained fields, derived from owner-captured report bytes, not a replacement full report. The archive/resource gates still validate other fields. Unknown top-level binding/projection ready flags reject; nested source records are bounded and checked for their exact required source references/types.
binding_context.provenance: Values must come from the future owner-local fresh immutable captured context and exact source/config graph. Standalone pure checking does not authenticate their origin.
binding_context.not_authority: No already_verified/ready/passed flag, arbitrary event allowlist, path-opening callback, numeric owner restart or cross-run capability is accepted.
references: protocol SHA and complete parent limits
terminal call report rows and final raw snapshot
final input recheck and status/failure/resumption report

fixtures_before_code.basis: Literal source-format synthetic event/details and reference projections, then writer-style canonical hash-chain serialization. No actual journal/SDK/writer/parent helper is executed.
valid: known-launched consistent source-negative including raw Unicode line separators
adversarial: deadline exceptions at bounded processing points
fixtures_before_code.mutation_rule: Some source/order attacks deliberately rebuild a valid chain, ensuring source checks cannot be replaced by byte-integrity checks. Fixed fixtures precede checker implementation; later tests may derive these declared fault families without changing their expected semantics.
